newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB DETAILS RAILCAR UNLOADS AT EXPORT POSITION.
newsitem.headline: CWB DETAILS RAILCAR UNLOADS AT EXPORT POSITION.

text.p: The number of railcars carrying grains and oilseeds unloaded at export position on Canada's Pacific ports fell below targeted levels in the week ended August 10 but exceeded targets at Thunder Bay, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
Vancouver unloaded 2,974 railcars versus the 3,050 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,154 railcars versus the 1,200 target. Thunder Bay unloaded 2,924 railcars versus the 2,800 target.
